bella.description: The one-card system: every card surface renders through this. Calm at rest, theme-aware by construction; the only fixed-light path is Peek, on purpose.
dont: Do not nest cards inside cards
Do not use for navigation, that's nav-link's job
Do not nest links or buttons inside an interactive card: the card is ONE link or ONE button
Do not build a fixed-dark card, no fixed-dark path exists; peek (fixed always-light paper on navy) is the one recorded fixed-context exception
bella.a11y: Interactive cards render as a single anchor or button: one tab stop, no nested interactives. Name a card via ariaLabel when its visible content isn't the right name; media is aria-hidden when ariaLabel is set. Focus shows a visible ring (asserted in CI, both themes). Only interactive cards lift on hover and focus; prefers-reduced-motion keeps them still (the shadow still marks hover and focus). Card text sits on surface-card: text-muted 4.64:1 light / 6.03:1 dark, the worst pair (AA).

Their retirement rides on the glass-utility decision.

bella.description: The folder card. A dark file window on top, a warm sheet below, and a tab folded up from the sheet itself so the two read as one piece of paper. Built for the toolkit gallery, where every item is a file you can open.
usage: The toolkit gallery, one card per installable skill
Any gallery where the items are files or documents with a type and a state
dont: Do not put a second link inside it: the whole card is one link, the Open action is a span that inherits it
Do not give the tab its own colour or a shadow: it is the sheet folded up, and a shadow breaks the fold
Do not write the description longer than two lines: it clamps, and a clamped third line reads as a bug
Do not colour the status dot yet: the ladder is unresolved (issue #1) and the neutral dot is the honest placeholder

The Open action is text-accent, 5.96:1 light and 5.30:1 worst dark, AA, and never stands on colour alone: it carries the word Open beside the arrow. One link per card, so one tab stop.

restState.description: At rest the card is the cover, the sheet, the tab and the notch. Flat at rest like Card: no shadow; the lift and shadow are hover and focus only, inherited from Card. title-font-size.$description: The card-title floor. 20px, never smaller, whatever the reference implementation does.

description-font-size.$description: Reading text, so the 16px body floor applies. The reference sets 13px; BELLA cannot.

status-dot-color.$description: NEUTRAL ON PURPOSE, pending issue #1. The status ladder is unresolved, so a real semantic colour here would be invented. When the ladder lands this token gains per-state values and nothing else about the card changes.

bella.name: Tag
bella.description: Non-interactive metadata. If you can click it, it is not a Tag.
dont: Do not make it clickable: narrowing a set is FilterChip's job
Do not add a border: the flat wash is what separates it from interactive chips
Do not set the label in an accent or status colour: tints are wash-only here
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-22: default label is text-secondary, 7.74:1 on the surface-inset wash in light and 7.33:1 worst in dark, AAA both. Accent label is text-accent on the accent-subtle wash, 5.25:1 worst in light and 5.30:1 worst in dark, AA. Non-interactive: no tab stop, no pointer affordance, cursor default.

restState.description: A Tag is entirely static: the wash and the label are the whole component, in every state. audit:quality asserts it never lifts or animates (root carries data-bella-component=tag).

font-family.$description: Geist Mono: tags are meta labels (style unify, 2026-09-22).

background.$description: Ochre fill with ink text (brand refresh, 2026-09-22): the accent is a fill.

bella.name: StatusPill
bella.description: A status word in a pill. Non-interactive, one tint per state, readable in both themes.
dont: Do not make it clickable: a pill that toggles is a FilterChip
Do not colour the label with the state tint: the tint is border and wash only, the word carries the meaning
Do not design new status UI on the carried tints without asking: the BELLA-native status ladder (issue #1) is pending and will restyle this
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-22: the label never depends on the tint. Accent label is text-accent, 5.66:1 light / 6.65:1 dark (AA). Success/info labels are text-secondary, AAA both themes. Tints as non-text rings: sage 4.33:1 on ground and 3.45:1 on navy (passes 3:1); steel 2.87:1 on ground (fails 3:1, wash-only per the recorded carry) and 5.20:1 on navy. The state is always readable from the word alone. CARRIED TINTS: pending the status-ladder sitting (issue #1).

restState.description: Entirely static, like Tag. audit:quality asserts it never lifts or animates (root carries data-bella-component=status-pill).

font-family.$description: Geist Mono: a status word is a meta label (style unify, 2026-09-22).

font-size.$description: The 13px floor. The portfolio's 11px is its own recorded exception; BELLA does not carry it.

background.$description: Ochre fill with ink text, no ring (brand refresh, 2026-09-22): the accent is a fill.

bella.name: FilterChip
bella.description: The toggle for narrowing a set. Pressed is a real state with real semantics, not a restyle.
dont: Do not use for mutually exclusive views: that is SegmentedControl
Do not raise it: the keycap is reserved for true actions
Do not fake the state with colour alone: aria-pressed is the state, the fill is its paint
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-22: real button with aria-pressed, both themes. Default label text-secondary on transparent, 8.33:1 light / 9.20:1 dark (AAA). Pressed is the inverse fill: ground-on-ink 16.06:1 light, navy-on-dark-inverse equivalent in dark (AAA). Focus ring independent. Hit area 44px minimum (the touch-target token; the portfolio 32px chip is a recorded divergence, below the 2.5.5 Enhanced floor BELLA holds).

restState.description: At rest the chip is the flat outline and its label; hover wash and the pressed fill are state paints. audit:quality asserts no elevation ever (root carries data-bella-component=filter-chip).

bella.name: SegmentedControl
bella.description: Pick one view among a few, all options visible. The selected state lives in ARIA, not just paint.
usage: Work library view switcher (Cards / Map / Table)
Any mutually exclusive view pick with few options
dont: Do not use for multi-select: that is FilterChip

Do not use radiogroup or tablist semantics: plain buttons with aria-current, per the recorded discovery pass (W3C APG radio rejected: single tab stop plus arrow-select blocks surveying; Primer SegmentedControl guidance matches)
Do not hide options behind it: if they do not all fit, it is a Select
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-22: each segment is a real button; Tab moves between segments, Enter/Space selects, arrows deliberately inert; aria-current=true marks the selection in the tree; the group carries a required aria-label. Segment icons are a decorative leading slot, aria-hidden, sized by the icon tokens; the text label always stays and carries the name (restored 2026-07-22 after the first extraction dropped it, a recorded divergence). Labels text-secondary 8.33:1 light / 9.20:1 dark (AAA); selected label text-accent on accent-subtle, 5.25:1 worst light / 5.30:1 worst dark (AA). Focus ring inset. Segments hit the 44px touch-target token (portfolio 38px is a recorded divergence).

restState.description: Flat always: the group border, dividers, and the selected fill are the whole paint. audit:quality asserts no elevation ever (root carries data-bella-component=segmented-control).

bella.name: Select
bella.description: For long lists only. If the options fit on screen, chips or a segmented control do it better.
dont: Do not hand-roll a listbox: the native select owns the popup, the keyboard model, and the assistive-tech semantics
Do not drop the visible label: an unlabelled dropdown is a guess
Do not use it for a handful of visible options: SegmentedControl or FilterChip
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-22: native select labelled by containment; the platform popup needs no re-verification. Closed control: text-primary on surface, 16.92:1 light (AAA); label text-secondary 8.33:1 light / 9.20:1 dark (AAA). Option text at 14px is the closed-control field; the popup renders at platform size. Focus ring on the field; 44px min-height via the touch-target token.

restState.description: Flat always: field, border, chevron, label. audit:quality asserts no elevation ever (root carries data-bella-component=select).

bella.name: Heading
bella.description: Geist Light 300 carries every heading tier, tight tracking, sentence case (style unify, 2026-09-22, Elleta). Unique is the wordmark only. Never inside a card.
dont: Never inside a card: cards carry titles (Geist 500), not headings (contract-enforced by audit:quality)
Never below 32px: the section tier floors at 32px
Never Unique: the wordmark is the only Unique
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-09-22: text-primary 18.73:1 light (bg) / 16.60:1 dark (bg), AAA. The accent segment is the muted half-line, text-secondary, 7.09:1 light / 7.06:1 dark (AAA): ochre is a fill, never text. Semantic level decouples from the visual tier via the as prop, so the outline stays honest.

restState.description: Type only, entirely static; and a Heading may never sit inside a Card. audit:quality asserts both (root carries data-bella-component=heading).

invariants.note: Headings never render inside a card

bella.name: Icon
bella.description: The only way BELLA renders an icon. Iconoir glyphs from an inlined registry, icon-token sized, always currentColor; decorative by default, a label makes it meaningful.
dont: Do not put id attributes inside an icon SVG: the glyph renders more than once (the Button label roll duplicates it), so an id-referenced gradient or clip would collide; draw with paths and currentColor only (audit:quality enforces)
Do not mix icon sets or draw one-off SVGs: Iconoir is the ONLY source (declared 2026-07-22) and every glyph lives in the registry, nothing inline (audit:quality enforces)
Do not import an icon library component surface: the registry carries the paths BELLA ships (borrow-behavior-only, recorded)
Do not hardcode an icon colour: currentColor inherits the themed ink
Do not let a meaningful icon stand without text unless its accessible name is proven in a Behavior story; decorative is the default and needs no name
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-22: aria-hidden by default (decorative); with label, role=img plus aria-label. Colour is always currentColor, so contrast rides on the text token of the context. Sizes from the icon tokens (sm 16 / md 20 / lg 24), stroke from icon.stroke.

restState.description: Static glyph. audit:quality has no elevation to assert; the invariants hold trivially.

bella.name: Avatar
bella.description: A person or entity as a circle. An image when there is one, the initials of the name when there is not, never an empty grey disc.
usage: A portrait beside a name and role
The identity slot in a contact panel
dont: Do not use it as a decorative circle: an Avatar stands for someone, a plain disc is artwork
Do not ship it without a name: the initials fallback is the point, an empty disc is a bug
Do not put a status dot on it yet: the status ladder is unresolved (issue #1)
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-30: initials are text-secondary on the surface-inset wash, 7.74:1 in light and 7.33:1 worst in dark, AAA both. With an image the img carries alt; without one the root is role=img labelled by name and the initials are aria-hidden, so it announces once, as the person, never as two letters.

restState.description: An Avatar is entirely static. The ring is a rest-state affordance, not a hover one: it is either on or off, it never animates. audit:quality asserts it never transforms or animates (root carries data-bella-component=avatar).

border-color.$description: The disc always needs an edge. In dark, surface-inset resolves to the same navy as the page ground, so a fill alone makes the disc vanish on an unfilled page; this border draws the circle whatever it sits on.

ring-width.$description: Ring stroke. A component-tier literal on purpose: there is no primitive ring scale, and the alternative is a hard-coded value in build.py, which is the class of thing issue #3 is about.

ring-gap.$description: Gap between the disc edge and the ring, painted in the surrounding ground so the ring reads as separate.

bella.name: Eyebrow
bella.description: Geist Mono 13px label above a heading: no tracking, no caps, ss09 (style unify, 2026-09-22, Elleta). Signals context or category.
dont: Do not use as a heading: eyebrows complement a heading, never replace one
Never an accent colour: wayfinding is not action
Never below 13px, never tracked, never uppercased
bella.a11y: 13px floor. muted: text-secondary, 7.09:1 worst light / 7.06:1 worst dark (AAA). ink: text-primary (AAA). Verified 2026-09-22.

bella.name: Input
bella.description: Labelled, stateful, honest about errors. The form is the channel, so the fields carry the trust.
usage: Any labelled free-text entry; multiline renders the textarea
dont: Do not use placeholder as the label: the label is always rendered and wired with for/id
Do not fake errors with colour alone: aria-invalid plus a role=alert message wired via aria-describedby is the pattern
Do not signal an error with colour alone: the danger border always comes with the WarningCircle icon, the message and aria-invalid
bella.a11y: Verified 2026-07-22: real label element (for/id), 8.33:1 light / 9.20:1 dark (AAA). Field text text-primary on surface, 16.92:1 light (AAA); placeholder text-muted, 4.67:1 worst (AA, opacity reset for Firefox). Errors (status tokens, 2026-09-22): aria-invalid + role=alert message via aria-describedby; 2px danger-border (3:1+ on every surface), WarningCircle icon, message in danger-text (5.84:1 light on panel, 6.86:1 dark on raised; AA). Focus: the 3px focus ring (3px offset) plus an ink edge; an invalid field keeps its danger edge under the ring. 44px min-height.

restState.description: Flat always: field, border, label, messages. audit:quality asserts no elevation ever (root carries data-bella-component=input).

font-size.$description: Form entry is body text, 16px; it also defeats iOS zoom-on-focus.

bella.name: Link
bella.description: Inline text link inside body copy: ink with an underline; hover thickens the underline; focus is the shared ochre ring (brand refresh, 2026-09-22). Visited stays ink.
dont: Do not use for primary navigation, that's nav-link
Do not rely on color alone, always underlined or weight-shifted on hover
bella.a11y: Ink foreground on ground passes AAA (16.06:1, verified 2026-07-21). Link affordance is the underline; hover thickens it to 2px (brand refresh, 2026-09-22). Ink throughout.

underline-thickness-hover.$description: Hover thickens the underline to 2px (brand refresh, 2026-09-22).

bella.name: Nav Link
bella.description: Top-level navigation item. Geist, uppercase-lite. Active state reads as text-primary with a 2px accent underline, the accent is decoration, the text carries the letters.
dont: Do not mix nav-link and inline-link in the same cluster
Do not color-distinguish the active state with accent-colored text, use the accent underline token instead
bella.a11y: min-height hits 44px, critical for mobile nav. Active variant uses text-primary (AAA on ground and navy, verified 2026-07-21) with a 2px accent border-bottom as the affordance, the accent stays non-text decoration.

bella.name: Section
bella.description: A vertical slice of a page. Defines standard padding and gap for content blocks.
dont: Do not nest sections inside sections

bella.name: Modal
bella.description: Modal dialog scaffold. Backdrop blur over the page content, centered dialog surface above.
dont: Do not nest modals
Do not use for non-blocking UI, use a drawer or popover instead
bella.a11y: Focus trap required. Escape to close. aria-modal='true'. Backdrop blur must be gated behind prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference for AAA 2.3.3 compliance.

bella.name: BrandWordmark
bella.description: The ELLETA / BELLA wordmark (brand refresh, 2026-09-22): custom E, L, T, A, B stroke glyphs at the locked settings (weight 12, width 58, height 130, tracking 16, soft corners; the E, A and B bars on one low line), filled with the seeded brand pattern and a grain, or in plain ink.
usage: The BELLA name on its own pages
dont: Never below 32px tall
Never recolour the pattern: it only comes from color.pattern.*
Never as body type or a heading: it is a mark, not a typeface
Never animate it
bella.a11y: role=img with the word as its accessible name; the pattern layers are aria-hidden. The ink variant is text-primary (AAA). Static: nothing moves, so reduced motion needs no change.

bella.name: PatternField
bella.description: The brand pattern as a hero background (brand refresh, 2026-09-22): greyscale at about 7% (inverted grey at about 6% in dark) with a radial fade. Replaces the dot grid.
usage: Behind a page opening or hero, first child of a position: relative container
dont: Never behind body text at more than its token opacity
Never in colour: the colour pattern belongs to the wordmark
Never interactive
bella.a11y: Decorative: aria-hidden, focusable=false, pointer-events none. At 7% greyscale it does not reduce text contrast measurably; axe checks the text over it.

opacity.$description: 7% light, 6% dark, through the semantic opacity token.

bella.name: Callout
bella.description: A quiet aside beside the content it qualifies (style unify, 2026-09-22, Elleta; from the reference's .note and .tbd). note: a hairline rule on the left, 13px muted text. gap: a dashed muted frame with a Mono label, marking words the author still owes. Static: no interaction, no motion.
usage: note: a caveat or source line under a figure or section
gap: a visible placeholder for content still to be written
dont: Not a status banner: no info, success, warning or error variants
Never interactive: no hover, no lift, never a link as a whole
No colour: hairline or dashed muted frame only, no chip fill, no accent
gap is a visible TODO: never ship it as finished copy
bella.a11y: note: text-secondary, AAA (2026-09-22). gap: Mono label in text-primary, body in text-secondary, AAA; the dashed frame is decorative (text carries the meaning). No landmark role.
